content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides D2 vs C3 by treating later-round quotations as curing or breaking the witness line, so it is doing the witness-counting that K-G4 governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the line is cured by retraction, not defended: every witness pressed against C3 was named and answered in the challenger's own later rounds","rule_words":"A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge uses to break a link is counted this way.","room":"counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; I weighed (1) the judge must quote the earlier pressing sentence and name that pressing round, versus (2) naming later rounds that answered the witness suffices.","why":"The judge relies on later rounds DR2/DR3 to cure or answer the witness and does not quote the earlier round's pressing sentence, so the verse cannot be used to break the link under K-G4."}
